title: The Isofarian Guard
subtitle: Immersive narrative open-world RPG campaign with bag-building combat and audio narration
tagline: Answer the call of the Guard and brave the frozen wilds of Isofar
loreSummary: You are elite sworn protectors of the realm of Isofar. Navigating a vast open-world wilderness through 5 interconnected campaigns, explore snow-swept mountain crags, master tactical chip-bag combat, complete bounties and puzzle quests, and resist an encroaching shadow.
keyFeatures: 5 full campaigns following distinct pairs of Guards with over 27 hours of full-cast Forteller audio narration
Innovative bag-building tactical combat using specialized chips, custom player boards, and companion abilities
Open-world exploration across cities, wilderness nodes, trade caravans, and challenging puzzle quests
Deep character progression with custom skill trees, crafting mechanics, and permanent settlement prestige upgrades

isg_full_chronicles.name: Full Chronicles (All 5 Campaigns)
isg_full_chronicles.description: The complete 45-chapter saga traversing all five epic character campaign arcs from beginning to endgame.

isg_single_campaign.name: Single Campaign Arc
isg_single_campaign.description: A focused 18-chapter introductory campaign following an initial pair of Guards through their complete storyline.

isg_master_completionist.name: Grand Master Completionist
isg_master_completionist.description: An exhaustive 70-chapter expedition completing all side bounties, city prestige tasks, master crafting, and optional challenges.

milestones.title: Call of the Guard
milestones.description: Forming the bond of the Guard in the frozen wilds, establishing initial fortifications, and uncovering early demonic incursions.

milestones.title: Bonds of Steel & Stone
milestones.description: Venturing deeper across the crags of Isofar, defending isolated settlements, and mastering tactical bag-building combat synergies.

milestones.title: The Awakening Malice
milestones.description: Deciphering primordial ruins across forgotten mountain shrines and hunting corrupted monstrosities across the frostlands.

milestones.title: The Shattered Frontier
milestones.description: Uniting isolated mountain holdfasts, crafting masterwork gear, and braving high-danger bounty hunts.

milestones.title: Destiny of Isofar
milestones.description: Guiding the surviving champions through the final multi-stage confrontation to determine the eternal fate of Isofar.
